name: Manor Estates & Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Manor Estates & Industries Ltd is in the business of Real Estate and Construction activity[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MEIL (formerly Karan Woo-Sin Ltd) used to be a 100% Export Oriented Unit engaged in the production and export of high quality cotton socks. 
But the production was stopped in 2013 and new objects of warehousing and construction were taken up in 2014. 
The company has commenced its new business of civil construction and real estate operations on October 15th, 2021.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
